digest.component_or_area: config ownership gate (RP-04 S7.3) — reconciler engine, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, mcp server
propositions: Direct ambient config/credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) and configurable adapter defaults exist below approved composition seams across reconciler, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm, and mcp_server subsystems; each must be cut to seam or registered with rationale.
The legacy-exception set must reach EMPTY with no path-glob exceptions; no bare below-seam ambient reads, backend reloads, or facades remain untracked.

Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions are removed only after their focused suites pass and redacted snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes are verified unchanged or record approved deltas.
All S1-S6 behavioral suites remain green after each subsystem cutover and after legacy-facade removal; provider-neutral correctness is the oracle.
The real tree config-ownership gate passes with EMPTY legacy-exception set on main; no path-glob exceptions remain.

Reconciler and provider canaries (check-access probe, dry-run/live status, LLM-Review, bounded-live call) pass; no credential leakage, no unauthorized fallback, retry count 0; rollback retains S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor.
